quality_boundary: Current plan identity kept as published (the Seventh Okazaki City Comprehensive Plan in a Comprehensive Policy Guidelines / Future Investment Plan / individual plans structure; the guidelines are ten-year policy guidelines looking thirty years ahead with target year FY2050, and the Future Investment Plan moved from its first period (FY2021-FY2025) to the latter period (FY2026-FY2030, revised March 2026), which is the current plan, with ten fields holding 54 main initiatives, all enumerated, plus the four cross-field Future Investment Packages; the first period is kept only as a separate version), progress governance (the ten fields are grouped into four groups for target setting and progress management with reference indicators per group, and the packages' project lists are revised as circumstances change), budget enactment kept as voted on 2026-03-23 as bill No. 56 at the March 2026 regular session (the session's voting-results list itself was not retrieved, so the exact 'passed as proposed' wording is not asserted) with the amount kept at the published sen-yen precision and never expanded into synthetic yen, and settlement totals kept at the published yen precision from the official settlement overview (certification bill No. 1 certified on 2025-09-30) without collapsing proposed, enacted, supplementary, or settlement states.
